description: CONDITIONAL bound on the Erdős minimum overlap constant µ assuming the optimal f* is even (White §6 conjecture). Halved-variable encoding (d=0, dlt=0, v=w) plus Bochner+Lasserre lifts. Path B 1-D ellipse extension on the p-axis (h=q=0).
caveats: CONDITIONAL: µ ≥ this only if the f-even conjecture holds.
LP solver returned optimal_inaccurate; values are within ~1e-5 of the true LP optimum.

Highest stable bochner_n under split-solve attempt was bn=20 (5s) and bn=30 (timed out at large T). For final reported numbers we use the bn=25 prior run from symmetric_conditional.json which was the highest convergent level under the standard encoding.

Path-B ellipse uses UNCONDITIONAL duals from lasserre2_path_b/row{5,6}.json (bn=20, T_max=30, T_loc=8) but conditional V_c. This is a slight approximation: the conditional duals would differ but the (concave-)quadratic shape is dominated by the (5.4) and (5.13) duals, which are robust under the assume_even reduction.

highest_settings_attempted.note: These values are at small T (loose tail bounds) and are LOWER than the prior bn=25 conditional run at full N=10000, T=4000. The full N,T configurations at bn>=25 timed out under the 45s sandbox cap even with split-solve; the build phase succeeded but solve did not complete in 40s for bochner_n>=30 with N>=4000, T>=1500.

interpretation.comment: The conditional bound µ_even ≈ 0.379904 is ONLY ~7.6e-05 above the unconditional 0.379828. This MARGINAL improvement is consistent with the optimal LP solution being NEAR-EVEN (small d_k, v_j ≈ w_j) even WITHOUT explicitly enforcing it. The f-even conjecture is therefore neither strongly supported nor strongly contradicted by these numerics: if true, we get only a tiny conditional improvement; if false, the unconditional bound 0.379828 is unaffected.
